sources.name: LesLII, the Lesotho Legal Information Institute (supported by the Judiciary of Lesotho, the Law Office and the Law Society; on the Laws.Africa Peachjam platform)
sources.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0, crediting LesLII as the source (https://lesotholii.org/terms-of-use/, read from the Internet Archive's copy)
sources.notes: Point-in-time expressions of each act, /akn/ls/act/<year>/<num>/eng@<date>. Each expression page is read from an archived copy (the Internet Archive's raw id_ form, or Common Crawl), never from LesLII's own pages; the capture timestamps and sha256s are pinned in sources.json.

sources.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
sources.licence: Archived copies of LesLII pages; the content licence is LesLII's
sources.notes: CDX API for discovery, then https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<original url> for the page bytes, through scripts/gitlaw_common/wayback.py (one adaptive rate for the whole machine).

acts.title: Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act, 2008
acts.label: Act 4 of 2008

decisions: Acts were chosen by what the archives hold. Of the 142 LesLII act works with an archived expression page, only two have more than one archived expression: the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2008 (3 expressions: 2008-04-10, 2013-03-28, 2015-09-25) and the Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act 2011 (2 expressions: 2011-01-11, 2021-01-14). Each of their versions is read from its own dated expression.

The Constitution of Lesotho 1993 has no archived LesLII (Peachjam) expression page: the Internet Archive holds no /akn/ls/act/1993/... page for it. Its 1993 text as made is read from the archived page of LesLII's earlier website (lesotholii.org/ls/legislation/num-act/1993/1), in corpus.d/10-constitution.json; see that part's own decisions.

Licence and terms: LesLII licenses primary and secondary law content CC BY-NC 4.0, crediting LesLII as the source; its terms (section 4) prohibit scraping and bulk downloading from its website, and its robots.txt sends Content-Signal ai-train=no, ai-input=no and Crawl-delay 5. No LesLII page was fetched from lesotholii.org: every page, including the terms and robots.txt, is read from an archived copy (Internet Archive, or Common Crawl), for the configured acts only. The user decided on 2026-10-28 that reading these archived copies is acceptable (relayed by the coordinator: "scraping wayback is fair game, dont overdo it"). The repository stays private; CC BY-NC allows only non-commercial use. No legal text was given to a model.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the configuration and the Constitution parser and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py is deterministic code.
